profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer I @ Axon | Python Django Postgres Geospatial | Protecting Life and Scaling Unified Intelligence
profile.summary: Software Engineer with a background in Geospatial and Higher Education.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Django · PostgreSQL · Django REST Framework · SQL

positions.title: Senior Lecturer
positions.description:
Performed academic advising for students enrolled in the Environmental Spatial Analysis BS program for the Lewis F. Rogers Institute for Environmental and Spatial Analysis (IESA).  Served on the IESA board as a voting member.  

Taught sections of the following courses:


GISC 2011 - Geographic Information Science
GISC 2011L - Geographic Information Science Lab
GISC 2012K - Fundamentals of Spatial Analysis
GISC 2202K - Fundamentals of Data Acquisition and Management
GISC 2203K - Fundamentals of Remote Sensing
GISC 3200K - Python Programming for GIS
GISC 4011K - Data Acquisition and Management
GISC 4022K - Spatial Database Design
GISC 4350K - Remote Sensing of Environment
GISC 4470K - Spatial Analysis in GIS
GISC 4500K - Application Development
GISC 4530K - Geospatial Web Application Development

positions.title: Adjunct Instructor
positions.description: Taught sections of GISC 2011 - Geographic Information Science and GISC 2011L - Geographic Information Science Lab.  Developed and taught GISC 3200K - Python Programming for GIS.

positions.title: Science and Technology Teacher
positions.description: Taught science and technology at the Da Vinci Academy in Oakwood, Georgia.

positions.title: Outreach Coordinator
positions.description: Responsible for coordinating efforts to increase GIS education in high school and technical college system of Georgia.  Worked individually with teachers and instructors, developed course materials, deployed desktop virtualization technology and taught classes to K-12 students.  Also evaluated competency models and assist in development of articulation agreements between Georgia institutions.  The National GeoTech Center was established by a grant from the Advanced Technological Education program of the Division of Undergraduate Education of the National Science Foundation.

company.name: National GeoTech Center Southeast, Gainesville State College

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Responsible for performing tasks in support of improving the Authority's GIS database.  Collected GIS data in the field such as manholes, valves and other water infrastructure and differentially corrected the collected data to prepare it for inclusion into the database.  Scanned over 10,000 water service contracts for inclusion into GIS linked financial and service ticket system.

company.name: Jackson County Water and Sewerage Authority

positions.title: Nutrition Care Specialist
positions.description: Taught nutrition classes, managed patient appointments and assisted registered dieticians in conducting research in the Outpatient Nutrition Clinic of a regional military hospital.

company.name: Department of Defense, United States Army

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Assisted Dr. Suzanne Leclair in conducting research in sedimentology.  Assisted in data collection on Mississippi river using differential GPS system, acoustic digital current profiler, a 1MHz transducer and high-precision echo sounder as processed resulting data.  The objective of this research was to improve sediment transport models.

educations.schoolName: AMU & APU part of American Public University System, Inc.

honors.title: Summer Undergraduate Research Grant
honors.description: Received funding to work with senior student Crystal Lyliston on a summer undergraduate research project centered on rural cemetery preservation.  Our project continues on as http://theyburied.us/
honors.issuer: Issued by Center for Undergraduate Research and Creative Activities at the University of North Georgia · May 2014
